accident_timeline.source_evidence: CCTV, Witness statements, CDR, GPS data, Postmortem, FSL

events.event: Maid Sunita Yadav starts work at victim's house
Maid Sunita Yadav reaches as usual for evening work
Victim Meena Devi watches TV in living room, maid working in kitchen
Daughter Rekha Sharma leaves for night shift in Gurugram
CCTV confirms Rekha exits through front gate, drives away
Maid Sunita Yadav finishes work and leaves
Accused Sanjay Sharma leaves his house C-78 Sector 24 in cousin's Swift car
Accused seen walking on road near Shanti Kunj Park
Accused parks car near Shanti Kunj Park
Accused (grey sweater) enters back lane of B-142
Accused uses duplicate key to open side gate of victim's house
Accused enters through back window of victim's house
Victim sees accused inside her house and shouts in surprise
Argument begins between accused and victim about property sale
Neighbour Ramesh Chand hears loud argument from victim's house
Argument escalates, accused's voice mentioning 'property' and 'Sonipat' heard by neighbour
Accused picks up kitchen knife from dining table
First stab wound inflicted - victim begins screaming
Loud scream heard by neighbour Ramesh Chand
Victim attempts to defend herself - defensive wounds on palms
Accused inflicts multiple stabs - chest wounds
Fatal incised wound to neck severs carotid artery
Victim collapses in living room, accused stands over her
Victim dies from hemorrhagic shock (approx 3 minutes after fatal wound)
Accused wipes knife on curtain, wraps it in cloth
Accused changes clothes (removes bloodstained outer layer if any)
Accused exits through back window
Accused exits side gate carrying cloth-wrapped object
Accused clearly identified on CCTV under streetlight
Accused seen walking towards park, fast pace
Accused enters Swift car DL3CCW1234, drives away
Car seen passing Sector 23 market towards Outer Ring Road
Accused reaches cousin Arun Sharma's house in Gurugram
Accused hides murder weapon under kitchen sink at cousin's house
Rekha Sharma returns home, finds main door unlocked
Rekha enters, sees mother lying in pool of blood, screams for help
Rekha checks pulse - no response. Calls out for neighbours.
Neighbour Ramesh Chand rushes to help, calls PCR
PCR call made to 112 by Rekha Sharma
PCR van Z-56 arrives, cordons off area
Ambulance arrives, victim declared dead on examination
Body shifted to DDU Hospital mortuary
FIR No. 912/2024 registered at PS Dwarka Sector 23
Forensic team arrives at scene, begins evidence collection
Spot panchnama completed
CCTV footage collected from 3 sources
Postmortem conducted at Safdarjung Hospital
CCTV analysis identifies accused as suspect
Police team dispatched to apprehend accused
Accused arrested from Delhi-Gurugram border
Accused medically examined at DDU Hospital
Murder weapon recovered from cousin's house at accused's instance
Detailed statement of accused recorded
FSL final report received confirming all evidence
Investigation completed, chargesheet approved by ACP

accident_timeline.timeline_consistency_check: All times cross-verified with CCTV footage, witness statements, postmortem findings, GPS data, and mobile CDR. The interval between victim's death (21:50) and body discovery (23:32) is consistent. No contradictions found.
